AddSubscription.name: AddSubscription
AddSubscription.description: This API is used to add a subscription to a specified topic. If the status of the subscription is unconfirmed, a confirmation message is sent to the subscriber. After confirming the subscription, the subscriber can receive notification messages published to the topic. By default, 10,000 subscriptions can be added to a…

AddSubscriptionFromSubscriptionUser.name: AddSubscriptionFromSubscriptionUser
AddSubscriptionFromSubscriptionUser.description: This API is used to add a subscriber to a specified topic. The subscriber is already in the subscriber list.

BatchCreateOrDeleteResourceTags.name: BatchCreateOrDeleteResourceTags
BatchCreateOrDeleteResourceTags.summary: Adding or Deleting Resource Tags in Batches
BatchCreateOrDeleteResourceTags.description: This API is used to add or delete tags in batches for a specified resource. You can add a maximum of 10 tags to a resource. The API is idempotent. When you are creating tags, if there are duplicate keys in the request body, an error is reported. If a to-be-created tag has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will…

BatchCreateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.name: BatchCreateSubscriptionsFilterPolices
BatchCreateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.summary: Creating Message Filter Policies for a Subscriber
BatchCreateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.description: This API is used to create message filter policies for subscribers.

BatchDeleteSubscriptions.name: BatchDeleteSubscriptions
BatchDeleteSubscriptions.description: This API is used to delete subscriptions in batches. The deletion result of each subscription endpoint is displayed in the response body.

BatchDeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.name: BatchDeleteSubscriptionsByTopic
BatchDeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.summary: Batch Deleting Subscriptions from a Specified Topic
BatchDeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.description: This API is used to batch delete subscriptions from a specified topic. The deletion result of each subscription endpoint is displayed in the response body.

BatchDeleteSubscriptionsFilterPolices.name: BatchDeleteSubscriptionsFilterPolices
BatchDeleteSubscriptionsFilterPolices.summary: Deleting Message Filter Policies of Subscribers
BatchDeleteSubscriptionsFilterPolices.description: This API is used to delete message filter policies of subscribers.

BatchUpdateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.name: BatchUpdateSubscriptionsFilterPolices
BatchUpdateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.summary: Updating Message Filter Policies of Subscribers
BatchUpdateSubscriptionsFilterPolices.description: This API is used to update the message filter policies of subscribers.

CancelSubscription.name: CancelSubscription
CancelSubscription.description: This API is used to delete a specified subscription.

ConfirmSubscription.name: ConfirmSubscription
ConfirmSubscription.description: This API is used to confirm the subscription of messages published to the topic.

CreateApplication.name: CreateApplication
CreateApplication.description: This API is used to create a platform application.

CreateApplicationEndpoint.name: CreateApplicationEndpoint
CreateApplicationEndpoint.description: This API is used to add an endpoint to a platform application.

CreateKmsKey.name: CreateKmsKey
CreateKmsKey.summary: Binding a KMS Key to a Topic
CreateKmsKey.description: This API is used to bind a KMS key to a topic. A KMS key is applied 5 minutes later after being bound to a topic. After the KMS key is applied, all messages published to the topic, including subscription confirmation messages, subscription cancellation messages, and topic messages, are encrypted and decrypted using th…

CreateLogtank.name: CreateLogtank
CreateLogtank.summary: Binding a Cloud Log to a Topic
CreateLogtank.description: This API is used to bind a cloud log to a specified topic to record information such as the message sending status of the topic.

CreateMessageTemplate.name: CreateMessageTemplate
CreateMessageTemplate.description: This API is used to create a message template for quick message sending and reduced request data volume. By default, a user can create a maximum of 100 message templates. However, in rare high-concurrency scenarios, extra templates may be successfully created.

CreateNotifyPolicy.name: CreateNotifyPolicy
CreateNotifyPolicy.description: This API is used to create a notification policy.

CreateResourceTag.name: CreateResourceTag
CreateResourceTag.description: You can add a maximum of 10 tags to a resource. The API is idempotent. If a to-be-created tag has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.

CreateTopic.name: CreateTopic
CreateTopic.description: This API is used to create a topic. Each user can create up to 3,000 topics. In high-concurrent scenarios, a user may create a few topics more than 3,000. The API is idempotent. It returns a successful result after creating a topic. If a topic of the same name already exists, the status code is 200. Otherwise, the sta…

DeleteApplication.name: DeleteApplication
DeleteApplication.description: This API is used to delete a platform application.

DeleteApplicationEndpoint.name: DeleteApplicationEndpoint
DeleteApplicationEndpoint.description: This API is used to delete an application endpoint.

DeleteKmsKey.name: DeleteKmsKey
DeleteKmsKey.summary: Deleting the KMS Key Bound to a Topic
DeleteKmsKey.description: This API is used to delete the key bound to a topic.

DeleteLogtank.name: DeleteLogtank
DeleteLogtank.description: This API is used to unbind a cloud log from a specified topic.

DeleteMessageTemplate.name: DeleteMessageTemplate
DeleteMessageTemplate.description: This API is used to delete a message template. After you delete the template, you can no longer use it to publish messages.

DeleteNotifyPolicy.name: DeleteNotifyPolicy
DeleteNotifyPolicy.description: This API is used to delete a notification policy.

DeleteResourceTag.name: DeleteResourceTag
DeleteResourceTag.description: This API is used to delete resource tags. The API is idempotent. When deleting a tag, the system does not check its character set. The tag key cannot be left blank or be an empty string. If the key of the tag to be deleted does not exist, 404 will be returned.

DeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.name: DeleteSubscriptionsByTopic
DeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.summary: Deleting a Subscription from a Specified Topic
DeleteSubscriptionsByTopic.description: This API is used to delete a subscription from a specified topic.

DeleteTopic.name: DeleteTopic
DeleteTopic.description: This API is used to delete a topic.

DeleteTopicAttributeByName.name: DeleteTopicAttributeByName
DeleteTopicAttributeByName.description: This API is used to delete a specified topic policy.

DeleteTopicAttributes.name: DeleteTopicAttributes
DeleteTopicAttributes.description: This API is used to delete all topic policies.

DownloadHttpCert.name: DownloadHttpCert
DownloadHttpCert.description: This API is used to download an HTTP message verification certificate.

DownloadHttpSignCert.name: DownloadHttpSignCert
DownloadHttpSignCert.description: This API is used to download an HTTP signature certificate.

ListApplicationAttributes.name: ListApplicationAttributes
ListApplicationAttributes.description: This API is used to query attributes of a platform application.

ListApplicationEndpointAttributes.name: ListApplicationEndpointAttributes
ListApplicationEndpointAttributes.description: This API is used to query attributes of an endpoint.

ListApplicationEndpoints.name: ListApplicationEndpoints
ListApplicationEndpoints.summary: Querying the Endpoints of an Application
ListApplicationEndpoints.description: This API is used to query the endpoints of an application.

ListApplications.name: ListApplications
ListApplications.description: This API is used to query platform applications.

ListCloudService.name: ListCloudService
ListCloudService.summary: Querying the List of Authorized Cloud Services
ListCloudService.description: This API is used to query the list of authorized cloud services.

ListCloudServices.name: ListCloudServices
ListCloudServices.summary: Querying the List of Authorized Services
ListCloudServices.description: This API is used to query the list of authorized services.

ListLogtank.name: ListLogtank
ListLogtank.description: This API is used to query cloud logs bound to a specified topic.

ListMessageTemplateDetails.name: ListMessageTemplateDetails
ListMessageTemplateDetails.summary: Querying Details About a Message Template
ListMessageTemplateDetails.description: This API is used to query template details, including the template content.

ListMessageTemplates.name: ListMessageTemplates
ListMessageTemplates.description: This API is used to query the template list by page. The list is sorted by template creation time in ascending order. You can specify offset and limit. If no template has been created, an empty list is returned. The parameters message_template_name and protocol are added.

ListProjectTags.name: ListProjectTags
ListProjectTags.description: This API is used to query all tags of a resource type in a specified region.

ListProtocols.name: ListProtocols
ListProtocols.description: This API is used to query the list of protocols supported by SMN.

ListResourceInstances.name: ListResourceInstances
ListResourceInstances.description: This API is used to query resources by tag.

ListResourceTags.name: ListResourceTags
ListResourceTags.description: This API is used to query tags of a specified resource.

ListSubscriptions.name: ListSubscriptions
ListSubscriptions.description: This API is used to query the list of all subscriptions by page. The list is sorted by subscription adding time in ascending order. You can specify offset and limit. If no subscription has been added to the topic, an empty list is returned.

ListSubscriptionsByTopic.name: ListSubscriptionsByTopic
ListSubscriptionsByTopic.summary: Querying Subscriptions of a Specified Topic
ListSubscriptionsByTopic.description: This API is used to query subscriptions to a specified topic by page. The list is sorted by subscription adding time in ascending order. You can specify offset and limit. If no subscription has been added to the topic, an empty list is returned.

ListTopicAttributes.name: ListTopicAttributes
ListTopicAttributes.description: This API is used to query a topic policy.

ListTopicDetails.name: ListTopicDetails
ListTopicDetails.description: This API is used to query details about a topic.

ListTopicMessageStatistics.name: ListTopicMessageStatistics
ListTopicMessageStatistics.summary: Querying Sending Details of a Topic
ListTopicMessageStatistics.description: This API is used to query the data sent by a topic. You can query all metering data of the last 31 days.

ListTopics.name: ListTopics
ListTopics.description: This API is used to query topics by page. The topics are sorted by creation time in descending order. You can specify offset and limit. If no topic has been created, an empty list is returned.

ListTopicsWithAssociatedResources.name: ListTopicsWithAssociatedResources
ListTopicsWithAssociatedResources.summary: Querying the Topic List Along with Their Associated Resources
ListTopicsWithAssociatedResources.description: This API is used to query the topic list along with their associated resources. The associated resources will grow as the service expands. By default, topics are sorted by creation time in descending order. You can specify **offset** and **limit** for pagination query. If no topic is found, an empty list is returned.

ListVersion.name: ListVersion
ListVersion.summary: Querying the SMN API v2 Version
ListVersion.description: This API is used to query the version of SMN API v2.

ListVersions.name: ListVersions
ListVersions.description: This API is used to list all SMN API versions.

PublishHttpDetect.name: PublishHttpDetect
PublishHttpDetect.description: Specifies the HTTP or HTTPS detection messages sent based on topics. These messages are used to check whether the current HTTP or HTTPS endpoint is available and whether the SMN egress can access the endpoint.

PublishMessage.name: PublishMessage
PublishMessage.description: This API is used to send messages to all subscription endpoints of a topic. After a message ID is returned, the message has been saved and is to be pushed to the subscribers of the topic. To send messages to subscribers successfully, ensure that your message content complies with local laws and regulations. Three mess…

ShowHttpDetectResult.name: ShowHttpDetectResult
ShowHttpDetectResult.description: This API is used to query the detection result based on **task_id** returned by the HTTP detection.

ShowKmsKey.name: ShowKmsKey
ShowKmsKey.summary: Querying the KMS Key Bound to a Topic
ShowKmsKey.description: This API is used to query the ID of the key bound to a topic. Before binding a KMS key, create an agency named **smn_kms_agency** on IAM and assign resource operation permissions to SMN. SMN uses this agency to query key information.

ShowNotifyPolicy.name: ShowNotifyPolicy
ShowNotifyPolicy.description: This API is used to query a notification policy.

SubscribeTopic.name: SubscribeTopic
SubscribeTopic.description: This API is used to confirm the subscription to a topic.

UnsubscribeSubscription.name: UnsubscribeSubscription
UnsubscribeSubscription.description: This API is used to unsubscribe from a topic.

UnsubscribeTopic.name: UnsubscribeTopic
UnsubscribeTopic.description: This API is used to unsubscribe from a topic.

UpdateApplication.name: UpdateApplication
UpdateApplication.description: This API is used to update a platform application.

UpdateApplicationEndpoint.name: UpdateApplicationEndpoint
UpdateApplicationEndpoint.description: This API is used to update application endpoint attributes.

UpdateKmsKey.name: UpdateKmsKey
UpdateKmsKey.summary: Updating the KMS Key Bound to a Topic
UpdateKmsKey.description: This API is used to update the key ID. Before updating a KMS key, create an agency named **smn_kms_agency** on IAM and assign resource operation permissions to SMN. SMN uses this agency to query the key status and create a data key.

UpdateLogtank.name: UpdateLogtank
UpdateLogtank.description: This API is used to update a cloud log bound to a specified topic.

UpdateMessageTemplate.name: UpdateMessageTemplate
UpdateMessageTemplate.description: This API is used to modify the message template content.

UpdateNotifyPolicy.name: UpdateNotifyPolicy
UpdateNotifyPolicy.description: This API is used to modify a notification policy. You need to include all parameters required in the request body.

UpdateSubscription.name: UpdateSubscription
UpdateSubscription.description: This API is used to update the subscriber remarks.

UpdateTopic.name: UpdateTopic
UpdateTopic.description: This API is used to update the topic display name.

UpdateTopicAttribute.name: UpdateTopicAttribute
UpdateTopicAttribute.description: This API is used to update a topic policy.
